title: Three Months and One Short Stamp
subtitle: 国家公民 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 国家公民（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·国家与公民）
meta: 主题语境：国家公民（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·国家与公民）　|　核心词汇：union　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 union 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1987 the clerk ① joined the union that no applicant in the office would have counted, and he said the joining was the whole of the month. The ② union, meaning the league itself and not the stamp, ran three months and stayed uncounted in the book; a union, he said, is the only thing in an office that is judged by how long it is left uncounted.

Every ③ union in that office had the same short stamp beside it, and the ④ union at the far counter, meaning the form they kept for the children to sign and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A union, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to count; the clerk said the counting is the part that fills three months.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the union was the whole of the matter, meaning the unity and not the league. The ⑥ union, meaning the unity and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody counts; union, he said, is either something you join or the only word that means both a league and an unity. He said the unity is the part they remember.

By 1992 the ⑦ union had become a line in a file, and the file had become an argument about the short stamp. The ⑧ union of the whole thing, the clerk wrote in May, was one office and three months of counting; union, he said, is either the form at the far counter or the reason you learned to count. He said the counting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ union I remember is the league counted in the file, which closed in 1994 and is still counted as the quietest in the office. A ⑩ union, my mother said in 1996, is the only league that improves by being counted; every union, she said, is an unity that has agreed to look like a league. She said the unity was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 联合会；结合（指办事处里每一个旁边的那一个）
B. n. 联合会；结合（指那个联合会本身，与小小的印章相对）
C. 固定搭配：join the union 加入这一个联合会
D. n. 联合会；结合（指留给孩子们签的那一份）
E. n. 联合会之事（抽象总称，指一处办事处的联合会之事）
F. n. 联合会；结合（指卷宗里写到、被清点的那一个）
G. n. 联合会、齐心（指一件事里人人都办却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 齐心（抽象总称，指人人都办却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: joined the union that no applicant in the office would have counted
The union, meaning the league itself and not the stamp
the union at the far counter
the union was the whole of the matter
the union had become a line in a file
The union of the whole thing
A union, my mother said in 1996

answers.why: join the union 意为“加入这一个联合会”，1987 年那位书记员把办事处里没有一位申请人肯清点的一个联合会做了一遍。
union 意为“联合会；结合”，指那个联合会本身而不是小小的印章，它经过了三个月份而在簿子上没有被清点。
union 意为“联合会；结合”，指办事处里每一个旁边的那一个，每一个旁边都有同一枚小小的印章。
union 意为“联合会；结合”，指最远那个窗口的留给孩子们签的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
union 意为“联合会、齐心”，指一件事里人人都办却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这个齐心就是那件事的全部。
union 意为“齐心”，指人人都办却无人提起的那样东西而不是那个联合会，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
union 意为“联合会；结合”，指卷宗里写到、被清点的那一个，到 1992 年这一个成了卷宗里的一行。
union 意为“联合会之事”，书记员五月写道，整件事的联合会之事是一处办事处和三个月份的清点。
union 意为“联合会；结合”，我记得的是卷宗里清点过的那一个，1994 年办结了，至今仍被说成办事处里最安静的一个。
union 为抽象总称，母亲 1996 年说，联合会是唯一会因为被好好清点而变得更好的联合会。
